purpose: Controlled ranking fixtures for R0 requirement 4. Synthetic and non-peer. These vectors are constructed, not model embeddings, and are never labelled as such.
revision_note: v1 varied semantic vectors only in magnitude along a single axis. Cosine discards magnitude, so the baseline scored every record at 1.0 and produced a six-way tie broken alphabetically, which made the ranking-delta evidence non-probative. v2 varies semantic direction so the baseline expresses a real ordering, while retaining one pair that differs only in affective magnitude.

records.intent: Exact semantic direction, very weak affect. Baseline ranks it top because affect is invisible to it. Affect-preserving policies should demote it.
Semantic direction off by a small angle, strong aligned affect. Should rise under affect-preserving policies.
Same semantic angle as the record above, affect pointing elsewhere. Isolates affect direction from semantic direction.
Genesis flag raised. Under ordinary cosine geometry the flag is an orthogonal component and penalises the record. The anchored policy must not penalise it.
Invariant flag raised, otherwise identical to the Genesis record. Isolates flag handling from the rest of the geometry.

Identical semantic direction and identical affect direction to semantic-near-affect-intense, at five times the affective magnitude. The product policy must score it identically; the magnitude policy must separate them. This pair is the direct test of finding 2.
